# SpikeAttention

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spike-based attention mechanism that replaces dense matrix multiplications with sparse, event-driven spike operations to compute token relationships. Reduces the quadratic computational cost of standard attention, making large language models feasible on energy-constrained neuromorphic systems.
